Class ControllerManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.controller.ControllerManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualControllerManager
public class ControllerManager extends Object implements VirtualControllerManager
Application-level singleton that manages the full lifecycle of all lobbies and game sessions on the server.

Responsibilities:

  • Maintains four routing maps (clientId → lobby, game, nickname; game → nickname map) so that any incoming command can be dispatched to the right Lobby or GameController in O(1).
  • Accepts clients from network handlers via handleClientConnected(VirtualView) and routes their commands to the correct destination.
  • Orchestrates lobby creation, joining, nickname selection, totem selection, and lobby dissolution.
  • Starts a game when a lobby is full (startGame(String, List, List, Map, Map)); tears it down when it ends (removeGameController(String)).
  • Handles player reconnection: re-binds the new clientId and delegates to GameController.handlePlayerReconnected(String, VirtualView).
  • Recovers interrupted games from NDJSON log files on server startup (recoverGames(Path)), with a configurable reconnection window before orphaned games are discarded.

All public methods that mutate shared state are synchronized. In-game action methods (requestMoveTotem(String, char), requestResolveActions(String, List)) are intentionally not synchronized because GameController provides its own fine-grained locking.

Obtain the singleton via getInstance().

      public void startGame(String gameId, List<String> clientIds, List<String> nicknames, Map<String, VirtualView> views, Map<String,Totem> chosenTotems)

    • recoverGames

      public void recoverGames(Path logsDirectory)
      Starts recovery of any interrupted game sessions found in the given directory. For each .ndjson file that does not end with a GAME_ENDED record, replays the command log to restore the game state and waits 300L seconds for players to reconnect before discarding the session.
      Parameters:
      logsDirectory - the directory containing NDJSON log files (e.g. Path.of("logs"))
